hypotheses.P1_base_jvp_reproduces_the_prior_failure: All-source base-JVP finite Fisher fidelity lies between 0.50 and 0.65.
hypotheses.P2_midpoint_substantially_improves_finit: Midpoint-JVP reconstruction exceeds base-JVP fidelity by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.P3_two_point_gauss_is_a_useful_finite_pr: Gauss-2 reconstruction has at least 0.85 aggregate Fisher fidelity.
hypotheses.P4_four_point_gauss_nearly_reconstructs_: Gauss-4 reconstruction has at least 0.97 aggregate Fisher fidelity and 0.85 fifth-percentile individual fidelity.
hypotheses.P5_quadrature_error_converges: Aggregate reconstruction fidelity is nondecreasing from Gauss-2 through Gauss-4 to Gauss-8.
hypotheses.P6_gauss2_recovers_source_tensor_directi: Gauss-2 predicted versus exact source-delta tensor has median cosine at least 0.90.
hypotheses.P7_support_was_easier_than_amplitude: Gauss-4 improves all-source reconstruction over base JVP by at least 0.25, while improving exact-edge top-32 selection by at most 0.02.
hypotheses.P8_path_integral_transfers_across_layers: Gauss-4 reconstruction has at least 0.85 aggregate fidelity for every layer, corpus, and semantic family.
hypotheses.P9_local_support_is_stable_along_the_pat: Base- and endpoint-JVP top-16 source sets have median Jaccard overlap at least 0.60.
hypotheses.P10_four_points_are_close_to_eight: Gauss-8 improves aggregate reconstruction over Gauss-4 by at most 0.01.
